items.description: The changed items that were accepted.

anchors.description: Every anchor of the record with its recorded and current identity and current mount information; those with changed true were re-recorded (after a reboot, some file systems present a new st_dev). An anchor on a FUSE file system is refused (exit 20 unlinked, details.cause fuse_anchor).
